verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs say you can manage Jira issues through a built-in Jira UI, open Jira tickets from the PR screen, and have issue statuses update automatically from commit keys. So issue tracking is delivered through a Jira integration rather than natively. Nothing in the pack covers the specific planning features the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of milestones, time tracking, issue dependencies, native (non-Jira) issue tracking, and independent corroboration.
